frozen_fields.material: Keep rho0=2048,rhow1000,n0=.25,K89478488,G134217728,Kw67108864 and k0=float(1e-4) exactly; conductivity law OFF throughout. Gravity0,no wall/load/drainage/HG/SPR/viscosity/shifting/DDT. Current J-derived saturated and positive-k RH domain must remain valid; do not retune material/k to resolve a difference.
frozen_fields.constants: A=2^-9 m/s,epsilonJ=2^-10,kappa=2*pi/Lx,phi_i=4*kappa*(x_i-dp/2). Fields are smooth and periodic across XZ seams; no affine polynomial discontinuity across a periodic face.

Rebuild periodic images through the actual owner lifecycle. A frozen J field on this fixed lattice is an operator input,not a compatible deformed physical trajectory.

three_cases.name: uniformJ_periodic_dilation
three_cases.required: Actual theta RMS is nonzero; the two instantaneous ndot evaluations agree within their prior arithmetic budget because n is uniform. Periodic dilation has zero global mean but locally nonzero divergence,not uniform box expansion.

three_cases.name: nonuniformJ_translation
three_cases.required: Nonuniform n span is nonzero,translation velocity is nonzero,actual theta and both rates are numerical zero. This isolates weight variation from an empty or inconsistent velocity-difference branch.

three_cases.name: nonuniformJ_higher_periodic_velocity
three_cases.required: Same J/positions/support as the translation case; actual C(Vj) is recorded and must agree between these two cases. Mode4 is intentional: at x=dp/2,J is maximal and all nonzero supported sin(phi_j)*(x_j-x_i) terms have one sign because support2h gives max phase<pi; the weighted difference is therefore not the odd-symmetry zero of a naive affine test. Require a resolved nonzero difference,never retune the fields after seeing results.

one_actual_operator_pass_per_case: Fresh CPU initialization only,then declared frozen fields by native ID,normal-native Dcell update and actual periodic rebuild. Call actual Interaction_Forces once to obtain the same production corrected theta and actual current C(Vj);no Run,ComputeStep,SaveData,predictor/corrector history or time advance. Release scratch and restore/check covered native identity/geometry/physical arrays after every case. No actual Eq24 production implementation is introduced.

independent_evaluations.terms: Search all actual native+periodic fluid slots independently of production cell ranges. Use exactly the same actual stored Vj,C_i,CPU compression kernel operands and float-rounded velocity differences; define b_ij=(vj-vi).corrected_grad_i_Wij. C is a conditioned actual input,not an independently proved inverse or continuum gradient.
independent_evaluations.rates: theta_ref=sum(Vj*b); ndot_J_actual=(1-ni)*theta_actual; ndot_Lian=sum(Vj*(1-nj)*b); delta_ref=sum(Vj*(ni-nj)*b). Test ndot_Lian-ndot_J_actual=delta_ref using the actual-theta reference budget. Uniform n0 also gives Vj*(1-nj)=V0*(1-n0),not a hidden solid fraction inside current porovol2.
independent_evaluations.prior_roundoff: Before execution count supported neighbors N and use gamma_m=m*DBL_EPS/(1-m*DBL_EPS),m=64*(N+1). theta budget=gamma_m*sum|Vj*b|; identity budget=gamma_m*(sum|Vj*(1-nj)*b|+abs(1-ni)*sum|Vj*b|+sum|Vj*(ni-nj)*b|),plus propagated theta budget. Retain double-min only to express a zero scale,no dimensioned max(1) or5Pa tolerance. Float-rounded input/kernel/C are common conditioned operands; compare ideal analytic float-free fields only descriptively,not by silently folding their quantization into a double-sum budget. If actual operands are found different,hold and explain them before execution rather than widen a result-dependent budget.
independent_evaluations.nonempty: Case3 difference RMS must exceed100 times RMS of the declared combined identity/production-theta budgets and be nonzero at a native x=dp/2 witness. Record case1 actual-theta nonempty and case2 nonuniform-n/translation witnesses. Failure is retained,not cured by changing amplitude,mode,material or threshold.
